description: A man with shoulder-length dark wavy hair in a dark long coat sits hunched over an upright piano, playing with both hands while looking down at the keys. A lit candle stands on the piano top beside a stack of papers, and sheet music is open on the stand and lying on the keyboard lid. Behind him an arched stone-walled room has a window showing rain streaking across a dark street and foliage, and he sits on a rush-seat wooden chair. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text beyond an illegible maker's mark on the piano.
